race.comment: VOLESTAIN (7) enjoyed the step up in ground when going close to breaking his maiden. He runs in a similar race here. Was favourite in that so expect similar focus of attention in this. Has some important gear adjustments this time. Must go close. DELA BELLA (9) just keeps finding a few better. She has been getting way back in the field and charging home. Both runs here have been solid too. Include in all multiples. MIRRAWAY (11) never really came into it two weeks back. Those second-up runs have not been as good as the first ones. Fitter and in the mix. APPLE EYES (8) went so much better at Corowa. She sat a lot further forward in that. Can feature here.
